stem.en: Each change is made to a sound that is playing. Sort each one by what a listener notices.

text.en: The source vibrates 400 times a second instead of 200
The density changes twice as much from the average
The same note is played on a sitar instead of a flute
The listener moves further from the source
The wavelength gets shorter, in the same air
A syaahi is put on a drum skin

explanation.en: Pitch goes with frequency: a faster source, or a shorter wavelength in the same air, means a higher frequency. Loudness goes with amplitude: a bigger change in density is louder, and moving away makes the sound fainter. Timbre comes from the instrument: a sitar and a flute, or a drum with a syaahi, sound different even on the same note.

hints.en: For each change, ask: does it change the pitch, the loudness, or only the quality of the sound?
Timbre is what makes two instruments sound different on the same note.
